topic: Which of shadcn's chart decisions should our standalone-HTML corpus adopt, and which of ours are already better. Six angles, one per iteration, in order.

focus: Catalog delta and distinct forms versus variants

findingDetails.summary: 70 examples reduce to a smaller set of reader-question forms; tooltip entries are support variants.
Question-first catalog is the stronger comparison boundary.
Radar omission is deliberate; parallel-axes is the substitute.
Pie and donut are deliberate arc omissions; unit-grid and unit-ring substitute.
Potential gaps require product demand, not variant counting.
Schema-preserving standalone retargets use one CHART_DATA edit site across all 26 templates.
Shadcn separates data and config; key changes require at least two surfaces.
Standalone multi-series templates still have at least four semantic surfaces outside the data block when the data story changes.
Current checks protect structure, determinism, palette literals, and series indexing, not prose or unit meaning.
A manifest is only justified if arbitrary schema-changing retargets become a real requirement.

focus: Hover, tooltip, pointer, and keyboard contract

findingDetails.summary: Shadcn exposes useful local tooltip knobs for indicator, labels, formatters, and key aliases.
accessibilityLayer appears in 38/70 frozen files and is absent from all polar families.
Standalone role/label/table and inert-versus-tooltip registers are a stronger static corpus-wide floor.
Interactive standalone sources contain focusable legend controls, Enter/Space handlers, and bounded pointer reach.
No actual keyboard or pointer walk was possible because the in-app browser inventory was empty; runtime behavior remains unclaimed.
Adopt semantic formatter/key-alias ideas locally, not shadcn indicator/hide flags as global defaults.
Shadcn light has 16.0 degree minimum adjacent hue gap, 1.72:1 own-ground minimum contrast, and 0.058 minimum simulated deutan separation.
Shadcn dark improves to 71.1 degree hue gap and 2.92:1 own-ground contrast but has 0.084 minimum simulated protan separation.
Standalone categorical light/dark minimum hue gaps are 92.9/96.5 degrees and own-ground contrast is 3.37/3.38:1.
Standalone neutral and ordered ramps intentionally use no hue or one hue; their small hue gaps are not categorical failures.
Existing checker gates contrast, ramp step, emphasis, source equality, and literal consistency, but not CVD or hue gap.
Adopt shadcn-style indirection only; retain standalone role-specific ramps and numeric gates instead of the raw five-token ramp.
Shadcn exposes 22 natural, 3 monotone, 2 linear, and 2 step props but zero domain, baseValue, or connectNulls props.
Natural interpolation can introduce apparent extrema between measured observations; rendered overshoot was not tested.
Adopt explicit per-form interpolation choices and stackOffset expand where semantics warrant them, not natural as a default.
Standalone templates expose baseline, peak, tick, dual-scale, and finite-run gap decisions in source.
Standalone direct paths and incomplete-run handling are better aligned with preserving missing observations.
Domain, baseline, stacking order, ticks, and interpolation remain per-template judgement without semantic metadata.
Catalog and catalog-system enforce identity, row reachability, and declared color-system agreement; form-choice substitutions remain judgement.
Data-block, determinism, color-literal, and series-mapping checks partially enforce one-point retarget structure but not semantic prose/unit alignment.
Accessibility, number-format, interaction-hygiene, interaction-state, and pointer-contract-coverage enforce the static tooltip/table contract.
Card-readout and pointer-reach are browser-dependent and were not proven because no browser was available.
Palette source/index assertions enforce existing gates but not CVD or hue thresholds.
Domain, baseline, stacking, interpolation, null, tick, and semantic retarget decisions are not currently asserted.
Keyboard-contract, palette-cvd/hue, curve/data-accuracy, and retargetability assertion families require new metadata or policy.
